claims.text: Anthropic's Aug 20 post makes Computer Use, the Skills API, and the Files API generally available on the Claude Platform and adds a new browser-use tool.
claims.context: GA bundle statement in captured body.

claims.text: Computer Use operates software via screenshots (click/type/scroll, now multi-action turns); the browser-use tool targets web page elements structurally rather than pixels alone.
claims.context: Boundary distinction stated in captured body and docs.

claims.text: Skills API uploads/versions folder-based skills executed in Anthropic's sandbox; Files API offers upload-once ID references, expiration, higher limits, 1TB/org; both also ship on Microsoft Foundry while updated computer/browser tools are coming soon to Vertex AI.

limitations.text: Performance/latency improvement claims for multi-action turns are vendor-stated without benchmarks in captured bytes.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Files API is documented as not ZDR-eligible in secondary coverage; the captured first-party bodies do not state retention scope, so no retention claim is made here.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Computer use, Skills API, Files API generally available; browser use tool added.
targets.finding: Captured Anthropic first-party bodies confirm what became GA (Computer Use, Skills API, Files API), the distinct surfaces, and the browser/computer-use boundary.
